name: document_normalizer_denominator_epn_native_readback_v1
comparison: Existing per-user source and target calibration windows from the frozen EPN normalization protocol. Compare legacy max(Q95,epsilon) with document Q95+epsilon denominators per channel; do not train or score a classifier.
boundary: Numerical native-input sensitivity only. Archive SHA comes from the verified discovery manifest and is not rehashed by this run. Previously examined public users are not a new independent cohort. Small denominator differences do not prove identical predictions or deployment benefit.
